advice_items.quote: I'd probably be a little bolder than I was and I'd probably be a little bit more confident in who I was to make certain that I always remain authentic to who I was
advice_items.summary_en: Be bolder, have more confidence in yourself, and always stay authentic to who you are.
advice_items.summary_zh: 自信做真实的自己，处事更果敢大胆

advice_items.quote: you should be trying as many different things as you can try and by the way do it in a very bold audacious way and to have the confidence to go do it
advice_items.summary_en: Take bold risks and try as many different things as possible while you are young and have fewer responsibilities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 趁年轻无牵绊时，勇敢尝试各种新事物

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: super strong focus on the consumer who are you trying to serve and what type of problems are you trying to solve for those people
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain a strong focus on the consumer you want to serve and the specific problems you are solving for them.
advice_items.summary_zh: 高度聚焦目标消费者，明确为其解决痛点

advice_items.quote: chase your dreams get involved with something that you're passionate about and then try to solve a problem and remain curious
advice_items.summary_en: Chase your dreams, work on something you are passionate about, stay curious, and focus on solving a problem.
advice_items.summary_zh: 追逐梦想投身热爱，保持好奇并解决问题

advice_items.quote: we translated into Innovative product that people coveted and desired and wanted and we told really emotional cool stories that connected the consumer to the brand
advice_items.summary_en: Turn consumer insights into innovative, desirable products and tell emotional stories that connect customers to your brand.
advice_items.summary_zh: 倾听用户洞察做爆品，用情感故事连接品牌

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: I had a plan in place I set goals out for myself and I stuck with that plan... have a plan and I save 10 of my income
advice_items.summary_en: Create a financial plan with clear goals, stick to it, and consistently save 10% of your income.
advice_items.summary_zh: 制定理财计划并坚持执行，存下10%收入

advice_items.quote: when you listen to someone tell you hey there's this can't miss investment I've had a few of those and I've missed almost every time
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid 'can't-miss, for-sure' investment pitches—they rarely work out and will pull you off track from your financial plan.
advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕所谓“稳赚不赔”的投资，别偏离计划

guests.first_money_or_break: 在耐克从卖球鞋和T恤的基层做起，历任销售、零售到产品等多个岗位，最终晋升为耐克总裁。
guests.zero_start_advice: 半开玩笑称若性命攸关一年内赚100万美元，会开酒吧或发起GoFundMe众筹页面向大家求助。
